description.value:
Superior Shinobi is a five-level Class Mod focused on all-around excellence, reserve resources, perfect hits, epithets, and a large menu of Superior Techniques.

This integration adds the core features as functional compendium entries, every Epithet as an individual entry, grouped reference entries covering the Superior Technique pages, example unique techniques, Superior Shinobi feats, and Superior Adversary reference pages. The Superior Technique list is grouped as reference pages rather than broken into over a hundred individual one-click items.

Gain 4 Ability Score Increases (usable up to a maximum of 22), AC +1, Speed +30 ft, one Saving Throw proficiency of your choice, +1 to all Saving Throws, proficiency in 3 Skills, 3 Masteries for Skills you are proficient in, and you cannot roll below half on a Hit Die or Chakra Die when spending them in a Rest or Superior Reserves.

At Class Mod level 3, Superior improves again: gain 4 more ASIs (up to max 24), AC +2, another +30 ft Speed, one more Saving Throw proficiency, another +1 to all Saving Throws, 3 more skill proficiencies, 3 more Masteries, +1 to all Attack Rolls and DCs, and you always roll the maximum result on Hit Die and Chakra Die when spending them in a Rest or Superior Reserves.

You gain Reserve Die (2 at level 1, scaling up to 10 at level 5). Up to two times per round, at any time, you may expend a Reserve Die on either Health or Chakra. Roll a Hit Die or Chakra Die respectively without modifiers and gain that result as Temporary Hit Points and Chakra Points; Temporary Hit Points gained this way are doubled and last 1 minute. If you have no Reserve Die left, you may instead expend 1 Hit Die or Chakra Die. Each Class Mod level beyond 1st grants one additional use of Superior Reserves per round. You regain half your Reserve Die on a Short Rest and all on a Long or Full Rest.

You begin with 2 Superior Techniques and gain 2 more at each Class Mod level. These are powerful passive enhancements with active effects. Each Superior Technique has a Hit Die or Chakra Die cost, plus a limited number of free uses per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus minus 2. Each Technique may only trigger once per round as a Special Action, and you may only use up to 3 Superior Techniques per round. This pack organizes the large technique list into grouped reference entries in the Superior Techniques folder.

Every combat, track how many Reserve Die, Hit Die, and Chakra Die you expend through this Class Mod. At combat end, for every two spent, gain 1 Burden Point. Burden reduces your effectiveness and can eventually suppress major parts of the Class Mod. Burden recovery: Short Rest -2, Long Rest -8, Full Rest -14. At higher Burden thresholds you lose Reserve Die, take penalties to skills / attacks / DCs, weaken Perfect Hit, lose access to Supreme or even Superior, and can ultimately halve your maximum Hit Points and Chakra Points.

Once per round, before an Attack Roll or an enemy Saving Throw is rolled, you may declare it as a Perfect Hit. An Attack Roll Perfect Hit gains an expanded Critical Range and a bonus to hit. A Saving Throw Perfect Hit raises the DC and punishes low natural results with extra damage. Even on a non-critical / non-fumble, the target still takes bonus damage equal to half the relevant damage dice. At Class Mod level 4, the range and bonuses improve again. You may also use a Consistent Hit variant that gives a bonus to the attack roll or a penalty to the saving throw instead of the normal Perfect Hit critical effects.

At Class Mod level 3, choose an Epithet that defines your legend and grants a unique mechanical identity. At Class Mod level 5, your Epithet gains an additional feature. See the Epithets folder for the full list.

At Class Mod level 4, when you next benefit from Down-Time, either create a unique jutsu with your DM (without paying the normal Down-Time cost) or select two jutsu you know and add new personal enhancements to them, such as lower costs, extra damage, or wholly new mechanics. The Examples & Extras folder contains example unique techniques from the source PDF.
At Class Mod level 5, you have perfected what it means to be a Shinobi. You gain one additional Action, Bonus Action, and Reaction each round.
